intervention.note: single isolated change vs P5 sum; applied via REGISTERED_AMENDMENTS, never as an ad-hoc override

unchanged: all other LOCKED_HYPERPARAMS, architecture, predictor=diag, T1=A_SHARED, refresh schedule, threshold grid, checkpoint policy, evaluator
comparator: existing P5 'sum' checkpoints + result.json on matching folds (G6 folds 1-4)

predefined_interpretation.positive_f1_delta: descriptive evidence the variant performs better under this setup
predefined_interpretation.gradient_balance_change: mechanistic evidence about the modified objective
predefined_interpretation.neither_alone_proves: causal explanation of the original model's failure
predefined_interpretation.exposed_folds_status: all comparisons on folds 0-4 remain exploratory, not confirmatory

decision_rule: per-fold paired delta macro-F1 (A1 minus P5) reported descriptively; no significance claim

budget.expected: ~50-75 s/fold observed for G6, bounded by cap
